<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=01|day=8|content=

* The {{RMS|Queen Mary 2||2}} is christened by Queen [[Elizabeth II]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/3368707.stm |title=UK &#124; A new Queen to rule the waves |publisher=BBC News |date=2004-01-07 |accessdate=2015-10-25}}</ref>
* An [[RTÉ]] ''Prime Time'' investigation accuses the [[Garda Síochána]], the [[Republic of Ireland]]'s police force, of violent abuse of people arrested. Irish [[Minister of State (Ireland)|Minister of State]] [[Dick Roche]] accuses Gardaí of "torture" of one student beaten up in a [[Dublin]] police station, while a former judge accuses police of committing [[perjury]] in his courts. The Gardaí deny all allegations.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rte.ie/news/2004/0108/garda.html |title=Gardaí deny breakdown in discipline - RTÉ News |publisher=Rte.ie |date=2004-01-08 |accessdate=2015-10-25}}</ref>
* The United States withdraws a group of 400 weapons inspectors from [[Iraq]] after finding nothing of substance. 1400 inspectors remain.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.news.scotsman.com/latest.cfm?id=2386490 |title=News - The Scotsman |publisher=News.scotsman.com |date= |accessdate=2015-10-25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.utusan.com.my/utusan/content.asp?y=2004&dt=0109&pub=Utusan_Express&sec=World&pg=wo_03.htm |title=US weapons search team withdrawn from Iraq |publisher=Utusan.com.my |accessdate=2015-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070930185852/http://www.utusan.com.my/utusan/content.asp?y=2004&dt=0109&pub=Utusan_Express&sec=World&pg=wo_03.htm |archive-date=2007-09-30 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[American occupation of Iraq|Occupation of Iraq]]: Nine United States soldiers are reported killed after a [[UH-60 Black Hawk|Black Hawk]] helicopter makes an emergency landing near the central Iraqi town of Falluja.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/3379433.stm |title=Middle East &#124; Nine dead in Iraq chopper crash |publisher=BBC News |date=2004-01-08 |accessdate=2015-10-25}}</ref>
* The [[Carnegie Endowment for International Peace]] publishes a report accusing the United States of "systematically misrepresenting" the threat posed by "Iraq's weapons of mass destruction".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.news24.com/News24/World/Iraq/0,,2-10-1460_1467121,00.html|title=News24, South Africa's premier news source, provides breaking news on national, world, Africa, sport, entertainment, technology & more.|work=News24|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081205081222/http://www.news24.com/News24/World/Iraq/0,,2-10-1460_1467121,00.html|archive-date=5 December 2008|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Julian Borger in Washington |url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/usa/story/0,12271,1118424,00.html |title=Carnegie group says Bush made wrong claims on WMD &#124; World news |publisher=The Guardian |date= |accessdate=2015-10-25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mercurynews.com/mld/mercurynews/news/special_packages/iraq/7662169.htm|title=San Jose Breaking News, Sports, Weather, Traffic|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060905023321/http://www.mercurynews.com/mld/mercurynews/news/special_packages/iraq/7662169.htm|archive-date=5 September 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* The [[New Jersey]] legislature passes a bill creating a [[domestic partnership]] status for [[gay|same-sex]] couples, with many of the same legal rights as marriage. It becomes the fifth U.S. state to offer such a status to same-sex couples.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.boston.com/news/nation/articles/2004/01/08/nj_senate_oks_legal_rights_for_same_sex_couples_governor_expected_to_sign/ |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060822121918/http://www.boston.com/news/nation/articles/2004/01/08/nj_senate_oks_legal_rights_for_same_sex_couples_governor_expected_to_sign/ |archive-date=2006-08-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
